answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one pulse weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The knoll report shows the merge explicitly at each vine. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 13 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 13 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1406 identities would post 1175 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
